notice: Unit 58 photo-only trial. STOR24 asks you to submit your own facial photograph so authorised staff can test secure capture and private review for this booking. The photo will not be sent to Hikvision or used to open a door. The live portal copy expires after one hour, or can be removed sooner if you withdraw. The system makes encrypted database backups; a copy may remain in a backup if one runs while your photo is stored, and backup deletion is not yet scheduled. Do not submit if you do not accept that risk. Contact bookings@stor24.co.za to withdraw or ask about your data. This trial is optional and does not affect your existing access arrangements.
consentLabel: I am the named person. I have read the Unit 58 photo-only trial notice and agree to my photograph being stored for staff review under its stated limits. I understand this does not activate door access.
